title: HA/DR automation: multi-AZ Terraform + Helm updates + runbooks-as-code for Private Installer
author: Priya Nair
release_notes: Adds automated HA/DR tooling for Private Installer: multi-AZ Terraform modules, Helm chart HA profiles, restore/failover scripts, and runbooks-as-code. No breaking changes to existing installer workflows. Recommended: run a restore drill in staging before promoting to production.
description:
Motivation: Customers deploying the Private Installer in regulated environments require automated high-availability and disaster recovery (HA/DR) playbooks that are codified and testable. This PR bundles Terraform multi-AZ modules, Helm profile updates, upgrade/rollback hooks, and runbooks-as-code (markdown + execution scripts) to enable reproducible failover/restore drills.

Summary of changes: 1) Terraform: new modules/ha/ that provision multi-AZ networking, cross-AZ load-balancers, and stateful storage classes with configurable replication; added example workspaces (staging/prod) and a CI job to run plan checks. 2) Helm: private-installer chart gains an 'ha' values profile (values-ha.yaml) with anti-affinity, pod disruption budgets, and readiness gating for KV cache warmup. 3) Upgrade/rollback: added pre-upgrade hooks to snapshot PVCs and post-rollback smoke tests; rollback automation script to restore previous helm release + restore KV cache. 4) DR tooling: scripted restore-drill.sh that performs a simulated AZ failure, promotes standby replicas, validates data integrity, and records timings. 5) Runbooks-as-code: runbooks/ha-dr contains executable markdown actions (using the runbook runner) for failover, restore, and post-mortem capture. 6) Observability: new dashboards and alert rules (migrations/ha-dr-alerts.yaml) to track failover latency and KV cache cold-start regressions.

Testing performed: automated integration tests added to perf-canary (dedicated job running terraform apply in a short-lived multi-AZ sandbox), e2e smoke tests for upgrade/rollback hooks, and a manual staged restore drill executed in staging (results captured in runbooks/ha-dr/staging-drill-results.md). CI: initial terraform fmt/lint failed due to formatting; fixed and reran. One flaky e2e test failed on first run (timing) and passed on rerun; CI marked as pass.

Rollout plan: land to main, deploy to staging via existing private-installer pipeline, run a full restore drill with the on-call SREs following runbooks/ha-dr/drill-checklist.md, validate metrics and alerting, then promote to production with a canary and increased observability retention window for 24 hours.

Security & compliance: KMS/HSM integration unchanged; terraform variables marked sensitive and omitted from logs. No secrets in runbooks.

Notes: This PR intentionally keeps backward compatibility with existing single-AZ installs. A follow-up PR will provide automated cross-region replication (ENG-4330).

review_thread: Samir Patel (reviewed): Can you break the terraform module into network/storage submodules to make audits easier? Also request adding outputs for health-check target groups.
Priya Nair (author): Split network/storage into submodules and added health_check_target_group outputs; pushed new commit to address feedback.
Jordan Lee (comment): Helm readiness gating looks good, but telemetry shows potential increase in pod restart rate when readinessDelay is large. Can we gate with a feature flag?
Priya Nair (author): Added 'ha.readinessGate.enabled' flag with default true for HA profile and documented behavioral change in docs/upgrade-rollback.md.
Alex Gomez (approved): Verified restore drill in staging and reviewed runbook steps. Approving pending CI green.
CI Bot: terraform fmt/lint failed on first run (formatting).
Priya Nair: Fixed formatting and e2e timing; reran CI.
CI Bot: All checks passed (terraform plan check, helm lint, e2e smoke).

notes_for_releaser: Run the terraform plan job in a sandbox and validate the health_check_target_group outputs before deploying to production. Coordinate a canary window and ensure extended observability retention for 24 hours after rollout.
changelog_entry: Added HA/DR automation for Private Installer: terraform multi-AZ modules, Helm HA profile, rollback automation, DR restore drill scripts, and runbooks-as-code (staging tested).
